summary: Add Hermes and Codex discovery and installation adapters
description: Depends on GB-110. Add a repo-local Codex discovery bridge, Hermes tap/direct-install documentation, portable install helper with safe copy semantics, and readback tests without changing user-global configuration by default.
acceptance: Codex can discover the repo-local bridge; Hermes can install from the public repository or a local checkout; install paths are documented; dry-run and isolated HOME installs prove no unrelated files are changed.

evidence.summary: changed_files=.agents/skills/guru-benchmark/SKILL.md,scripts/install-skill.sh,docs/skill-usage.md,README.md,AGENTS.md,tests/test_skill_install.py,Makefile; verification=bash -n scripts/install-skill.sh && python3 -m unittest tests.test_skill_install -v && make check; result=passed 21 tests; critic=installer false failure reproduced with shell trace and fixed, existing installs require explicit force and retain backup; runtime=hermes

verification.command: bash -n scripts/install-skill.sh && python3 -m unittest tests.test_skill_install -v && make check

review.outcome: installer false failure reproduced with shell trace and fixed, existing installs require explicit force and retain backup

concerns: Hermes and Codex discovery and installation adapters must preserve canonical skill behavior without modifying global state by default.
